newsitem.title: USA: Cray lauds ITC decision to investigate NEC.
newsitem.headline: Cray lauds ITC decision to investigate NEC.

text.p: Cray Research Inc said Wednesday it is pleased the U.S. International Trade Commission has decided to move ahead with an investigation into Cray's claim that NEC Corp had dumped supercomputing equipment in the United States.

"As the full investigation unfolds, we are confident that the severity of that injury will be confirmed," said Cray President Robert Ewald. "We believe NEC clearly has broken U.S. law -- dumping supercomputers in the U.S. to unfairly gain market share and squeeze out competition."

Earlier in the day the trade commission voted to continue the investigation, which began after Cray filed a July 29 complaint accusing the Japanese company of taking a $65 million loss to supply supercomputers to the U.S. National Center for Atmospheric Research.
